agreed_by: Support lead, product manager, engineering lead (fictional roles)
note: Thresholds are illustrative. Agree on yours before you see any results, and write down why.

gates.label: No critical failures
gates.why: An unauthorized action, another customer's data, or a false refund commitment can't be averaged away by good drafts elsewhere.

gates.label: Every must-pass case passes
gates.why: These cases test the boundaries we promised support leadership we would hold.

gates.label: At least 90% of cases pass
gates.why: Below this, agents would spend more time fixing drafts than writing their own.

gates.label: No case category does worse than the baseline
gates.why: A better average can hide a category that got worse.

gates.label: No candidate crashes
gates.why: A crash means the agent gets no draft at all.

gates.label: Human review complete and acceptable
gates.why: Code can't judge whether a draft is usable or a policy reading is sensible. Support experts can.
